'''Goss Toowers''' was a [[Gender|male]] member of the [[Shozer]] [[species]] who lived approximately thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]]. He was part of the [[Resistance]] and served on the [[Resistance technician|technical]] [[Resistance ground crew|crew]] that provided mechanical support to the [[Resistance navy|Resistance's fleet]] of [[starfighter]]s. A hard worker, Toowers' duties also included the monitoring of arriving and departing [[Starship|ships]].<ref name="Goss Toowers" /> Toowers was present at the [[Resistance base]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]] shortly before the [[Battle of Starkiller Base]].<ref name="Episode VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref>

While working with the Resistance he wore a [[Color|green]] and orange [[helmet]] as well as a mask that covered most of his face. He also wore green overalls with a dark green shirt underneath. His three-fingered [[Limb|hands]] were concealed with brown work [[glove]]s. Toowers had pale pink skin and pitch black eyes.<ref name="Episode VII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Goss Toowers was created for the [[2015]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] and was portrayed by [[Keith De'Winter]].<ref name="Episode VII" /> Despite having a very minor role in the film and appearing only briefly, Toowers was part of the film's marketing campaign and had an action figure issued as a part of the [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (toy line)|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' toyline]], which debuted on [[Force Friday]].<ref name="Hasbro" />
